text:
kevin_customer: Hey support — trying to apply promo code SPRINGVIP2026 during checkout (kevin@acme.io / org acme-inc). API returns 422 "promocode_invalid_or_expired". Dashboard shows code active. Can you check?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact API request (or screenshots) and your org ID? I'll look up the redemption log.

kevin_customer: Org ID: org_3345
Request I sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_3345","code":"SPRINGVIP2026"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 422
{"error":"promocode_invalid_or_expired","message":"Code invalid or expired"}
```

maria_support: Thanks. Hold on, checking redemption logs...

billing-bot: PromoService: redemption recorded | code=SPRINGVIP2026 | user=invitee+aws@acme.io | user_id=usr_8910 | ts=2026-02-19T14:22:07Z

maria_support: That's the issue — the code was redeemed 2026-02-19 by invitee+aws@acme.io. Do you recognize that email? Sometimes guest invites consume one-time codes if the invite target redeems before account merge.

kevin_customer: Hmm we did have a contractor invited. They shouldn't have used it. Can you reverse or grant equivalent credits?

maria_support: We can issue a manual credit to your org for the same value. I'll escalate to billing for the manual grant and file an internal bug for the invite/alias flow so this doesn't happen again. @aj_billing can you apply a credit for org_3345 for $150 and attach credit_id?

aj_billing: Applied manual promo credit: credit_id=cr_20260317_778 | amount=$150 | applied_to=org_3345. Refund/credit will appear on the next invoice. Submitted internal ticket INF-452 to engineering to investigate invite alias redemption path.

sam_eng: I'll take INF-452 — preliminary guess: the redemption endpoint does not check pending-invite/future-merged-email mapping and allows one-time codes for invited email. I'll reproduce with invite flow and post steps.

maria_support: @kevin_customer I've applied the manual credit; can you confirm you see it in the billing UI under orgSettings -> Credits? If yes I'll close this thread.

kevin_customer: I see the credit, thanks! Please keep me posted on the fix.

maria_support: Will do. Follow-up: INF-452 tracking; ETA for fix: next sprint (2026-03-30). Closing this support thread. :white_check_mark:
